sloka: स पितृव्याय सङ्क्रुद्ध इन्द्रजिच्छरमाददे।उत्तमं रक्षसां मध्ये यमदत्तं महाबलः ।। ६.९१.४६ ।।
transliteration: sa pitṛvyāya saṅkruddha indrajiccharamādade।uttamaṁ rakṣasāṁ madhye yamadattaṁ mahābalaḥ ।। 6.91.46 ।।

translations.english: The arrows with red feathers of Vibheeshana having penetrated the body of Indrajith, piercing into the body they became red coloured seemed like a red serpent.
